Container.Name: PlexBridge
Container.Overview:
PlexBridge is a self-hosted Blazor app that syncs watch history, ratings and playlists between two Plex servers. What you have watched, how you rated it, and the playlists you keep on one server can be brought across to the other.
The web interface is on the port below. Everything PlexBridge stores is kept in the appdata folder, mounted at /config in the container. Not affiliated with Plex.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex sync watch history ratings playlists watched status two servers

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the PlexBridge web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings and data. Mounted at /config in the container.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID PlexBridge runs as. It owns the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for dates shown in the interface, for example America/Chicago.
